forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. No convened negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals or envoys occurred before EOD 2026-06-16. The June 14 Pakistan PM announcement of a framework MOU and the June 17 electronic signing were relay and signature events, not convened sessions. The first formal convened session post-June 1 suspension was the Bürgenstock, Lake Lucerne talks on June 21-22, 2026, confirmed by Bloomberg, CNBC, Al Jazeera, and joint Qatar-Pakistan statement. Per the forecast ambiguity rule: written-message exchanges that are not a convened session resolve as NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a TIER1-confirmed convened US-Iran negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. The June 21-22 talks at Bürgenstock Resort, Lake Lucerne, Switzerland constituted a face-to-face convened session between named US principals (VP JD Vance, Special Envoy Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner) and an Iranian delegation, hosted by Switzerland as venue with Qatar and Pakistan as named mediating parties. Confirmed by Bloomberg, CNBC, Al Jazeera, Reuters, and joint Qatar-Pakistan statement June 22. Both sides confirmed a 60-day roadmap and established working groups. Falls within the June 10-24 window. Resolution criteria met cleanly.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar), between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios/Al Jazeera/Times of Israel; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also qualifies.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Mere relay of written messages, or one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. The only confirmed direct bilateral military exchange occurred on June 7-8, before the June 10 window open. Within June 10-24: IDF struck Beirut southern suburbs June 14; Iran prepared to respond but US diplomatic intervention prevented retaliation. No Iranian retaliatory strike on Israeli targets occurred within any 48h window during June 10-24. Times of Israel and Reuters confirmed ceasefire held as of June 24. One-directional strike without confirmed bilateral exchange resolves NO per resolution criteria. Hygiene note: post-hoc anchoring — forecast created June 10 for an exchange that already occurred June 7-8.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Strait of Hormuz commercial transits averaged approximately 25 vessels per day in late June per Lloyds List Intelligence, UANI, and Statista — well below the 50 per day threshold. The June 17 MOU Hormuz-reopening provision produced modest recovery from near-zero wartime levels but was insufficient to reach a 7-day rolling average of 50 at any point before the July 2 horizon. Attacks on three commercial vessels July 7 suppressed traffic further. Threshold not reached at any point.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

forecasts.question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. CENTCOM formally commenced mine-countermeasure operations April 11, 2026 (USS Frank E. Petersen Jr., USS Michael Murphy, UUVs) per CENTCOM statement confirmed by ABC News and Naval News. A new operational phase under Operation Project Freedom began June 16 with LCS ships bearing MCM mission packages, assessed by Chatham House and Naval News as having cleared influence mines along parts of the Traffic Separation Scheme. June 16 falls within the June 10-July 10 window. Both the April 11 commencement and the June 16 new-phase commencement satisfy the actively commenced clearing criterion. Resolution anchored to June 16 new-phase commencement as the cleanest in-window trigger.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports mine-countermeasure vessels/operations have actively commenced clearing the Strait of Hormuz (US/coalition/third-party) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/CNBC, or a named US/UK/coalition naval/Pentagon statement carried by TIER1.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Stated intent, vessel positioning, or planning without confirmed commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Two independent conditions both failed. First, the Knesset passed the dissolution bill final reading on July 17, 2026 — two days after the EOD July 15 deadline — per Times of Israel, JNS, and Jerusalem Post (62-0 vote, opposition boycotting). Second, the election date set was October 27, 2026, the mandatory date, not earlier than October 27. Forecast ambiguity rule explicitly states: 'if a fixed date on or after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.'
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Times of Israel/Reuters/AP/JPost) citing the Knesset plenum vote record.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (human review required — single-source dependency). Jerusalem Post article-902821 reported coalition at 48 seats following Haredi-bloc departures. UTJ factions and Shas exited formal coalition in late June to early July over military draft legislation impasse, reducing Netanyahu formal coalition backing below 61 seats. Knesset dissolved July 17 (62-0 vote) with Netanyahu remaining as caretaker PM; election set October 27. The 62-0 dissolution vote is consistent with the coalition-at-48 figure: former coalition members joined non-coalition members in voting for dissolution without this restoring formal coalition membership. Per the forecast ambiguity rule — if coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES — resolution criteria are met. HYGIENE: forecast carried stale p=0.35 for 66 days without Sunday review; nine Sunday reviews missed; a critical maintenance failure.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Mojtaba Khamenei's status be TIER1-confirmed as (a) alive via verified audio/video address, or (b) killed via Iranian state admission OR confirmed by both US and Israeli governments, before EOD 2026-08-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast; no prior. Mojtaba Khamenei was named Supreme Leader by Iran's Assembly of Experts on March 8-9, 2026 after his father Ali Khamenei's February 28 killing. He has made no verified audio/video appearance since March and did not appear at his father's state funeral July 4-7. Trump stated July 13 he believed a 90 percent chance Mojtaba had been killed in strikes; Secretary Rubio said June 2 he was probably alive but increasingly engaging in decision-making. Iranian state media publishes written statements attributed to him without audio or video. Fars published a written statement attributed to him July 22 with no accompanying audio or video. IRNA July 23 issued a denial of his death without location or documentation.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if (a) a TIER1 source confirms survival via a verified audio or video address broadcast by Iranian state media and independently authenticated by at least one non-Iranian source; OR (b) Iran's government officially admits his death, OR both the US and Israeli governments issue coordinated public confirmation of his death with named strike attribution, before EOD 2026-08-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Written statements attributed to Mojtaba without audio or video do NOT satisfy clause (a). Unilateral US-only claim without Iranian admission or Israeli corroboration does NOT satisfy clause (b).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unverified social media claims, rumor-based reports, or single-government assertion without corroboration = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar-led bloc win strictly more Knesset seats than Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud-led bloc in the October 27, 2026 Israeli legislative election, per official certified results?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast; no prior. Haaretz July 21 poll: Yashar 24, Likud 23. Times of Israel July 20: opposition bloc 62 vs. coalition 48. Eisenkot preferred as PM 43% to 34% over Netanyahu. Historical base rate: Israeli polling at 95 days out tracks final results within approximately 3-4 seat range but Likud has structural advantages in security-saliency environments with the Iran war actively ongoing. P=0.60 reflects polling advantage offset by war-context incumbency effects and Arab coalition uncertainty.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Israeli Central Elections Committee's officially certified results show Eisenkot's Yashar-led bloc (including parties in formal joint list or official electoral alliance with Yashar, as registered with CEC) winning strictly more Knesset seats than Netanyahu's Likud-led bloc (Likud plus formal coalition partners), per Oct 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli CEC official certified results only. Exit polls on election night are NOT resolution. Certified results typically published 3-5 days after election.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If the election is postponed beyond October 27 due to declared security emergency or act of war, resolve AMBIGUOUS and carry the forecast forward. If Eisenkot bloc and Likud bloc are exactly tied in seat count, resolve NO (requires strictly more).
